title: Autoresearch swarm scoreboard schemas
description: JSON Schemas for the v4.2 autoresearch swarm scaffolding. Covers the swarm manifest, individual scoreboard.jsonl entries, and per-worker heartbeat files. Workers synchronize via a shared filesystem (Dropbox/iCloud/S3/NFS). Validation is best-effort; scripts are tolerant of forward-compatible additions.

skillName.description: A skill identifier as it appears in develop-like-sudipta/skills/<skill>/.

score.description: Normalized score in [0, 1] (per per-skill scorer contract).

manifest.title: Swarm manifest
manifest.description: Top-level config for a swarm. Lives at <swarm-dir>/manifest.json.

best_known_scores.description: Map of skill -> highest score ever published to this swarm.

scoreboardEntry.title: scoreboard.jsonl line
scoreboardEntry.description: Append-only log entry. One JSON object per line. Workers never rewrite earlier lines.

target_hash.description: sha256: prefix followed by the hex digest of the target file's contents.

scorer_mode.description: Identifier of the scoring mode used (wordlap, regex, llm, etc.). Cross-mode comparison is meaningless; merge_best only compares same-mode scores.

accepted_locally.description: Whether the worker's local run_autoresearch accepted this candidate.

proposal_id.description: Optional uuid/short-hash identifier of the proposal file in proposals/.

delta_from_local_baseline.description: score - (best accepted local score before this experiment). Signed.

notes.description: Free-form short note (e.g. 'added X trigger phrase').
